desc: Being safe and responsible is a cornerstone of the Ruger philosophy. With over 70 years of innovation and quality, Ruger offers the attention to detail expected from an industry leader, providing you with reliable gun cases, packs, and accessory gear. Upholding the very best in craftmanship, you will have the peace of mind needed to protect your investment when hitting the field or range. The Ruger 10/22 Safety Shooting Glasses & Foam Earplugs Combo Kit is an all-inclusive shooter safety kit, delivering everything you need to protect your eyes and ears while out on the range or field. High-grade polycarbonate lenses that meet ANSI Z87.1+ impact requirements, offering long-lasting wear. The protective lens is highly durable and scratch resistance, providing ultimate protection over the eyes and face while reducing scratches from wear and tear. The Ruger red soft foam earplugs conform to the shape of the ear for a custom fit, providing long lasting comfort for a day at the range. Easily worn within other earmuffs, the foam ear plugs offer an additional 32dB noise reduction rating. Choose safety and convenience with the Ruger 10/22 Safety Shooting Glasses & Foam Earplugs Combo to ensure your eyes and ears stay safe at the shooting range.
